title: Fix: the false trip on /api/0 (the crawler's refused-call count read as an endpoint), closed as raised in error; plain names for our endpoints; money always in
why: Found live after #258 (Jason's screenshots, 2026-11-23): (1) the crawler reports site_blocked as a count (crawler.py SITE_BLOCKED); #258 read it as a map of endpoints, so every report raised a trip on '/api/0'. Now a count over 0 is one refusal on /api/crawl/, and a map is read by named endpoints only. (2) That trip closes on its thread as 'Closed: raised in error', never Recovered; a close that isn't a recovery (Retire too) no longer reads 'Recovered: Closed'. (3) An endpoint with no register row reads by its path, never 'ep:…' (02 §5.4). (4) Money always in dollars ('/bin/bash.65', never '65.2¢', which read as $62) and a count with its unit ('469,266 calls'): Jason, 2026-11-23, 'Cents vs dollars'.
